claim: A habeas corpus petition may survive threshold dismissal when a petitioner demonstrates that prolonged unlawful detention arose from administrative errors traceable to a private employer's misrepresentation of work-release eligibility records. The court held that such third-party interference with custodial documentation can form a cognizable basis for collateral relief under 28 U.S.C. § 2241.
citation: Rolvstaad v. Dollar General Corp., 738 F. Supp. 3d 412 (S.D. Tex. 2019)
